newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran hangs three men for murders.
newsitem.headline: Iran hangs three men for murders.

text.p: Iran has executed three men convicted of murder in separate cases, a newspaper said on Tuesday.
The daily Iran said the men, sentenced to death by courts in Tehran for killing one person each, were hanged in Tehran's Qasr prison on Monday. It did not give details of the cases.
Convicted murderers in Iran are usually sentenced to death by hanging. Under the country's Islamic laws, the family of the victim can accept a sum as "blood money" and spare the life of the murderer.
